'''Savage Opress's lightsaber''' was a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] used by [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The weapon would see action on many fronts such as [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]], [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]], [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].

==Description==
[[File:SavageOpressLightsaber-WOTM.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Savage Opress practicing while sparring with his lightsaber]]
The weapon closely resembled [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], but also contained design features similar to [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus's]] [[Dooku's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] (notably the [[Blade emitter/Legends|emitter guards]] on both ends). Compared to typical lightsabers, this weapon had an unusual sound frequency where the ignition hiss sounded similar to an animal-like growl, while the idle hum had a much deeper resonance pitch. Also, the weapon's blade length extended much further than most other lightsabers.

==History==
===Serenno and Toydaria===
[[File:SavageScissored-WOTM.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Savage Opress losing his first spar in lightsaber combat with Darth Tyranus.]]
The lightsaber was first used in sparring duels with [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus's]] [[Dooku's lightsaber/Legends|weapon]]. It was later used during the [[Showdown at Toydaria/Legends|showdown on Toydaria]], during a three-way duel on a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|Separatist dreadnaught]] with Tyranus and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], and Opress's subsequent escape from the dreadnought, wielded against [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and numerous battle droids. On [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], he later brandished the weapon against a lone Jedi Knight, displaying aggressive skills in combat.

===Lotho Minor and Raydonia===
[[File:EnemyOfMyEnemyIsMyFriend-Revenge.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Savage Opress and Darth Maul battle Asajj Ventress and Obi-Wan Kenobi aboard their Turtle Tanker.]]
Opress carried it to [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]], in search of his brother. He ignited it and slaughtered a bunch of junkers. When he fell below, he ignited half of the weapon to provide light to navigate the abyss to find his brother. In the struggle with a near-mad [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], he lost the weapon but shortly retrieved it with a [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Pull|Force pull]] after Maul ran away. The lightsaber saw combat, in conjunction with his brother's [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|weapon]], above [[Raydonia/Legends|Raydonia]] against Obi-Wan Kenobi and Asajj Ventress.

===Outer Rim===
Savage would use his lightsabers against [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] at [[Yellowblade's Landing]], and it would be used to confront the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bruu Jun-Fan]] and [[Grohto]] at [[Pleem's Nexus]].

Opress would later wield the blade as he confronted the Jedi Masters [[Salmara]] and [[Judd]], and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Dray (Fallen Jedi)|Dray]] on Moorjhone. In addition to this, Savage wielded the lightsaber while dueling Jedi Knight [[Finn Ertay/Legends|Finn Ertay]] and her [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] companion at an unidentified [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] spaceport. Savage fended Ertay long enough for Maul to get behind her and [[Shiak|stab]] her in the back.

===Cybloc and Florrum===
Savage used the weapon on the [[Cybloc Transfer Station/Legends|Cybloc Transfer Station]] against the security droids, and used it to pry the credit coffer open. He would then use it against his brother when he suggested that they share equal power, throwing off the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]]. He was bested quickly, however. Opress deployed the weapon against Jedi Master [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], while his brother went off to face Kenobi. The lightsaber was used to execute her, after Opress used his horns to [[Shiak|impale]] her.
[[File:DuelOnFlorrum-Revival.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Savage Opress fights with Adi Gallia while Darth Maul duels Obi-Wan Kenobi on Florrum.]]

===Missions to Mustafar and Nal Hutta===
Opress would travel to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] with Maul, [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan]] and the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] to arrange an alliance with a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] faction led by [[Xomit Grunseit/Legends|Xomit Grunseit]]. When the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] refused to ally with Maul and his new [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]], Opress hurled the lightsaber at him, killing him as well as four other Falleen leaders.

Sometime later, Opress used the weapon on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] when [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] set [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] on them. The mission became a retreat, though they managed to rally several [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] enforcers. Opress used this weapon when he killed [[Oruba/Legends|Oruba]].

===Mandalore===
Savage would wield the lightsaber on Mandalore when the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] and the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] usurped [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|assumed control]] of the New Mandalorian [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] on Mandalore. He used it to kill the guards at the bank and then used it in a brief duel with Vizsla. Vizsla betrayed the two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and locked them up, but the two escaped. Maul would later kill Vizsla, therefore taking control of the Death Watch.

During the [[Battle of Mandalore/Legends|battle]], he would later wield it in a duel against the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], with the aid of his brother. It is here that Savage would meet his demise when Sidious [[Shiak|impaled]] him with [[Darth Sidious' lightsabers/Legends|two lightsabers]]. The lightsaber instantly fell to the floor.
